The function EthIf_ProvideTxBuffer shall forward the call to the respective Ethernet Controller Driver.

If the latest accepted controller mode is equal to ETH_MODE_ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST for the given EthIfController, then the function EthIf_ProvideTxBuffer shall forward the call to the respective Ethernet Controller Driver. Otherwise the function shall reject the request for a transmission buffer and return with E_NOT_OK.

If the latest accepted controller mode is equal to ETH_MODE_AC- TIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST for the given EthIfController, then the function EthIf_ProvideTxBuffer shall forward the call to the respective Ethernet Controller Driver or CanXL Controller Driver. Otherwise the function shall reject the request for a transmission buffer and return with E_NOT_OK .
